text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cefuroxime 1.5 g vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 158 vials (10.5 days on hand). Corvale General holds 367 vials (25.6 days on hand). The Hikma product (NDC 00143997722) is manufactured at HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. (FEI 3002807173).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection records for the Hikma plant show a VAI classification in 2011, an OAI classification in 2014, and subsequent VAI classifications in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2014-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at both campuses. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation protocols. The Hikma facility has a history of regulatory findings, most recently a VAI in 2023.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from B. Braun Medical Inc. (ranked option 1); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals as secondary source (ranked option 2); requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and Hikma plant inspection updates weekly; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
